answer: Beacon spot-checks and heartbeats block fake identities. Each identity registers one cipher key and proves work. At dawn the beacon issues a random challenge; each identity must answer within one hour with a signature, a whisper-quiet proof. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 answers: at 2 compute units daily, 2,000 units a day, while one honest agent pays 2. Honest agents keep undiluted rewards, since one heartbeat covers only one identity.
